subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Community science does not replace professional research.”?
options: A familiar object can make a new place feel ready for work.
When many careful eyes watch a place, problems can be noticed sooner.
It was a place where time, work, and relationships met before breakfast.
But after many years, it can become a record of ordinary days.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「A familiar object can make a new place feel ready for work.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Community science does not replace professional research. When many careful eyes watch a place, problems can be noticed sooner.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It was a place where time, work, and relationships met before breakfast.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「But after many years, it can become a record of ordinary days.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Community science does not replace professional research. When many careful eyes watch a place, problems can be noticed sooner.」，答案為「When many careful eyes watch a place, problems can be noticed sooner.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「When many careful eyes watch a place, problems can be noticed sooner.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
